title: Java and Kotlin
description: JVM projects with Maven or Gradle: Maven Central, the Gradle plugin portal and distributions, and GitHub open, everything else closed.

de.title: Java und Kotlin
de.description: JVM-Projekte mit Maven oder Gradle: Maven Central, das Gradle-Plugin-Portal und die Gradle-Distributionen und GitHub offen, alles andere zu.

notes: The JDK and Maven in an image variant: sandbox-ai images new jvm --from claude, sandbox-ai images extend jvm --add-apt default-jdk-headless --add-apt maven, sandbox-ai build --variant jvm, then --image-variant jvm. Gradle comes from the project's wrapper (services.gradle.org).
Another repository (your company's, Google's for Android) needs its host: --allow-host NAME on the command line.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
